manifest.name: Dark Mode Toggle
manifest.description: A light and dark switch for visitors. Follows the device setting, remembers the choice and never flashes on load. The dark colours are derived from your site's own colours.

panels.title: Dark mode
panels.description: The light and dark switch for visitors and the colours of the dark version. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Offer a dark version of the site
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: placement
fields.title: Switch position
fields.description: In the header puts the switch at the end of the menu. Pages without a header get the floating switch.

fields.name: background
fields.title: Dark background
fields.description: The darkest colour of the dark version. Leave empty to derive it from your colours.

fields.name: text
fields.title: Dark text
fields.description: The lightest colour of the dark version, used for text. Leave empty to derive it from your colours.

fields.name: overrides
fields.title: Colour overrides
fields.description: Optional. One design colour per line with its dark value, for example: surface.deep = #0f2a22

fields.name: label
fields.title: Switch label
fields.description: What screen readers announce. Leave empty for "Dark mode".

store.tagline: A light and dark switch that follows the device and never flashes.
store.longDescription:
Dark Mode Toggle gives every page of your site a dark version and a small switch for visitors. Before anyone chooses, pages simply follow the light or dark setting of the visitor's device. One click on the switch changes it, and the choice is remembered on every page and every visit.

There is nothing to design. The dark colours are worked out from your own design colours when a page is published: your lightest colour becomes a deep background, your darkest becomes the text, and everything in between follows, so text stays as readable as it was and your hues stay recognisable. Want more control? Pick your own dark background and text colour, or override single colours by name.

There is no flash of white when a page loads in dark mode: a one-line script in the page head puts the remembered choice back before anything is drawn. Form controls and scrollbars switch with the page.

The switch is a real button with an accessible name, a pressed state screen readers announce, a large target and a visible focus ring. Put it floating in a corner or at the end of your header menu. It only appears once its script has run, so visitors without JavaScript never see a button that does nothing. It is hidden when printing.

It is light: no third-party requests, fonts or images, about 2.5 KB in total. The only permission it asks for is storage, to keep its settings. Refuse it and the plugin still works with the defaults.
